Unveiling the truth of Jacob Wellan’s life, showcasing him as a good man… and an even better Pirate.

Title: The Phantom: The Complete Sundays Volume 10
Series Name: The Phantom: The Complete Sundays Volume 10
Media Rating / Age Range: T – Teen 13+ Suitable for teens, mild themes
Description of Issue /book:
"Referred to by comic strip historian Maurice Horn as the “granddaddy of all costumed superheroes,” The Phantom was created in 1936 by Lee Falk. The strip hit the funny pages of newspapers well before the Dark Knight or Superman made their first appearances and has been acknowledged as an influence on every “masked man of mystery” since. The Phantom set the standard for action, adventure, intrigue, and romance in adventure comic strips and comic books — it has frequently been copied but never equaled. 
   This exciting 10th volume of the full color Sundays continues the SY BARRY YEARS! Five complete continuities drawn by Sy himself which continue the adventures of The Phantom, Diana, and his two children. This volume starts with “Alexander's Diamond Cup” September 20, 1970 and concludes with “The Hawk Master” which concludes on February 11, 1973.  Also included is a comprehensive essay and documentary materials."
Brief Synopsis of Book: The Phantom set the standard for action, adventure, intrigue, and romance in adventure comic strips and comic books in a collection of the classic full color Sunday comic strips.

Title: Friar Rush #3
Media Rating / Age Range: T – Teen 13+ Suitable for teens, mild themes

However, Seraph is on the way to attempt to save him...can she make it in time, or is the earth--or at least New Orleans--doomed?
Brief Synopsis of Book:
Some evils were never meant to return.

Whispered legends and forbidden texts tell of Friar Rush—a demonic trickster who walked the Dark Ages, seducing the faithful and corrupting the Church from within. His victims were many. His damage, eternal.

History tried to forget him.

It failed.

Now he’s back.

When the brutal murder of a priest in New Orleans draws the attention of journalist Jake McGlover—a man with his own ties to the Church—he’s pulled into a nightmare beyond belief. His only ally is Seraph, an immortal cursed by the friar’s manipulations centuries ago and desperate to end them.

But Friar Rush has returned with purpose.

Because this time, he’s not content to damn a few.

He’s coming for everyone.

Title: Midnight Tiger: Origins Special Edition Issue A - Nex Vierling Cosplay CVR Variant
Series Name: Midnight Tiger: Origins Special Edition Issue A - Nex Vierling Cosplay CVR Variant
Media Rating / Age Range: T – Teen 13+ Suitable for teens, mild themes
Description of Issue /book: STUDIO SKYE-TIGER OFFICIAL LAUNCH! Critically acclaimed creator Ray-Anthony Height (Spider-Man, Miles Morales, Star Wars: Doctor Aphra) officially debuts his brand-new publishing imprint, Studio Skye-Tiger, by bringing back his most acclaimed superhero creation in an oversized, definitive format! Re-experience the pulse pounding origins of indie comics’ ultimate fan-favorite hero, Midnight Tiger! Gavin Shaw is a disillusioned, nerdy teenager living in Apollo Bay. Tired of elite "Capes and Tights" ignoring everyday despair plaguing the people in hit city, fate steps in when Gavin rescues the critically wounded superhero Lionsblood. That single choice alters Gavin’s destiny forever, granting him a rapidly evolving collection of superhuman abilities. Adopting the mantle of Midnight Tiger, Gavin takes the fight directly to what he believes is the problem, but he is completely unprepared for the darkness staring back at him. This special 44-page launch issue features 40 full pages of story content, collecting the ultra-rare Midnight Tiger #0, #1, the first three pages of #2, plus 2 brand-new, never-before-seen pages from Height!
Brief Synopsis of Book: THE DEFINITIVE ENTRY POINT TO THE SKYE-TIGER UNIVERSE! Before the upcoming ongoing series, discover how your new favorite teen protag' was born in this remastered, oversized epic from master storyteller Ray-Anthony Height! In a world teeming with celebrity superheroes, elite "capes and tights" soar high above the clouds, completely blind, and completely indifferent to the crushing, everyday despair suffocating urban communities below. Gavin Shaw was just a nerdy kid left to watch his hometown bleed and draining of hope while the rest of the world got saved, until a single act of pure bravery transforms him into Midnight Tiger. Now an urban force of nature armed with devastating power, indie comics’ ultimate fan-favorite hero hits the streets with a target on his back. What begins as a teenager's localized crusade violently collides with a dark reality, only to realize that street-level corruption is just the camouflage for a much larger, terrifyingly ancient rot. Can a raw, inexperienced young hero save his community before a hidden darkness swallows it whole? This is the complete, essential prologue that changes everything and sets the stage for Midnight Tiger: EVO!
